description: This file defines the MerchantLog entity class for the Shopizer e-commerce system. It models log entries associated with merchants, including fields for store reference, module name, and log message, and includes JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: MerchantLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a merchant log entry, including fields for id, store, module, and log message, with supporting constructors and getters/setters.

methods.description: Constructor to initialize MerchantLog with store and log message.
